Two Countries. Two Warriors. One Battle. One Survivor.

Nothing is more dangerous than the truth.

34108: Born a fully grown black man in a village in the Brazilian jungle, Macunaíma later magically transforms into a white man before making an adventure-filled trip to the city of São Paulo. Fra Diavolo, alias The Marquis De San Marco

35644: A hit man who wants out of the business is targeted by old colleagues.
Don't turn your back to the underworld.

37436: Enzo, 16, defies his bourgeois family’s expectations by starting a masonry apprenticeship, a path far removed from the prestigious life they had envisioned for him. 41532: When a movie crew arrives to shoot their film at an estate, they are haunted by the supernatural elements of the lonely house on the estate. Things get worse when the people of the estate and crew start disappearing.

A picture of Everybody for Everybody!

A voice that inspired a generation.
